# Member Management Solutions

## Transform your fitness business with ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness solutions simplifies operations, amplifies marketing and sales efforts, and enables a
dynamic member experience. Don't just run your fitness business—transform it.

[Get Demo & Pricing][45]
[ABC_dia02_2199_edit]
[https://abcfitness.com/wp-content/uploads/full-hero.mp4][46]

## A connected experience for every fitness business

Our mission is to help our customers turn their fitness visions into reality. ABC Fitness solutions
make it simple for businesses of any size to grow while empowering members to become the best
version of themselves through innovative, accessible tech.

[ABC_dia01_0618-updated][ABC_dia01_0618-updated]

## Tailored solutions for your unique challenges

Simplify operations and reach seamless scale with intuitive tech, transparent data insights, and
branded member experiences. ABC Fitness software is purpose-built to turn your business goals into
tangible growth.

### ABC Ignite

See why major global fitness brands choose ABC Ignite. From single operators to multi-location
franchises, our sophisticated suite of gym management solutions streamlines operations end-to-end
via accessible club management.

[ Explore The Platform ][47]

### ABC Trainerize

Whether you're an independent personal trainer or manage a fitness business, ABC Trainerize enables
you to expand your services online and offer personalized training programs to your members. Elevate
member engagement and drive community through our mobile app and software platform, designed for a
premium and personalized coaching experience.

[ Explore The Platform ][48]

### ABC Glofox

Discover a gym software platform nimble enough to power operations for boutique studios and gyms.
Whether you’re a start-up or a growing global franchise, amplify your brand and strengthen your
member experience at any scale with ABC Glofox.  

[ Explore The Platform ][49]

### ABC Evo

ABC EVO, Latin America’s leading club management software, empowers fitness businesses of all sizes
with a fully optimized system for country-specific banking, native languages, and regional
dialects. As part of the ABC Fitness family, ABC EVO provides a secure, flexible, all-in-one
solution trusted by operators to efficiently manage their clubs with ease and control.

[ Explore The Platform ][50]

## Frequently asked questions

### Frequently asked questions

#### [ What features does the software offer? ][75]

ClubWise is an all-in-one gym software solution that includes membership management, direct debit
collection, member engagement tools, class bookings, staff management, access control with QR codes
and integrated payments. It also offers performance dashboards and loyalty programs to help
streamline your fitness business management.

#### [ Is there a free trial or demo available? ][76]

Yes, ClubWise offers a free demo for its online gym software so you can explore how it simplifies
gym management software needs for your studio or gym.

#### [ How long does it take to set up the software? ][77]

Setting up ClubWise is quick and straightforward. As a gym studio software, it is cloud-based, and
its intuitive setup ensures your business is ready to run efficiently in no time.

#### [ Which third-party apps does the software integrate with? ][78]

ClubWise integrates with trusted payment platforms like Stripe and Global Payments. It also works
seamlessly with bio-metric readers, swipe cards and offline gym management software features.
ClubWise also has custom APIs so we can integrate with certain third party systems.

#### [ How secure is my data? ][79]

Your data is highly secure with ClubWise. As an FCA-accredited and BACS Facilities Management
Provider in the UK, the gym management software ensures compliance with the highest security
standards. All funds are kept in segregated accounts for peace of mind. ClubWise is also ISO 27001
certified. ISO 27001 is an industry standard, which defines best practices for managing information
security within an organisation, demonstrating a robust system for protecting sensitive data and
information.

#### [ What support options are available? ][80]

ClubWise provides comprehensive support for its online gym software, including onboarding
assistance, local and highly responsive customer service teams in both the UK and Australia and a
detailed help centre to help you manage your fitness business smoothly. We also offer a variety of
professional services such as Data Migrations, Campaign Sending and Bulk Price Increases.

#### [ Does ClubWise have a mobile app for members? ][81]

Yes, ClubWise has a member app you can use for member engagement, class bookings and payments. This
is our [FitSense][82] app but you can also white label it for your club.

## Frequently asked questions

### Frequently asked questions

#### [ What features does the software offer? ][75]

ClubWise is an all-in-one gym software solution that includes membership management, direct debit
collection, member engagement tools, class bookings, staff management, access control with QR codes
and integrated payments. It also offers performance dashboards and loyalty programs to help
streamline your fitness business management.

#### [ Is there a free trial or demo available? ][76]

Yes, ClubWise offers a free demo for its online gym software so you can explore how it simplifies
gym management software needs for your studio or gym.

#### [ How long does it take to set up the software? ][77]

Setting up ClubWise is quick and straightforward. As a gym studio software, it is cloud-based, and
its intuitive setup ensures your business is ready to run efficiently in no time.

#### [ Which third-party apps does the software integrate with? ][78]

ClubWise integrates with trusted payment platforms like Stripe and Global Payments. It also works
seamlessly with bio-metric readers, swipe cards and offline gym management software features.
ClubWise also has custom APIs so we can integrate with certain third party systems.

#### [ How secure is my data? ][79]

Your data is highly secure with ClubWise. As an FCA-accredited and BACS Facilities Management
Provider in the UK, the gym management software ensures compliance with the highest security
standards. All funds are kept in segregated accounts for peace of mind. ClubWise is also ISO 27001
certified. ISO 27001 is an industry standard, which defines best practices for managing information
security within an organisation, demonstrating a robust system for protecting sensitive data and
information.

#### [ What support options are available? ][80]

ClubWise provides comprehensive support for its online gym software, including onboarding
assistance, local and highly responsive customer service teams in both the UK and Australia and a
detailed help centre to help you manage your fitness business smoothly. We also offer a variety of
professional services such as Data Migrations, Campaign Sending and Bulk Price Increases.

#### [ Does ClubWise have a mobile app for members? ][81]

Yes, ClubWise has a member app you can use for member engagement, class bookings and payments. This
is our [FitSense][82] app but you can also white label it for your club.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is gym management software?

Gym management software helps fitness businesses manage bookings, memberships, payments, member
communication, and reporting in one connected platform. ABC Glofox is designed to help studios and
gyms simplify operations and grow revenue faster.

Who is ABC Glofox built for?

ABC Glofox is built for fitness studios and gyms, from startups to scaled international franchises.
It supports a wide range of fitness businesses, including yoga, Pilates, boxing, HIIT, PT, and
multi-location operators.

Can members book classes and manage their accounts online?

Yes. Members can book classes, appointments, and other services through the member app and web
portal, while also managing payment details, memberships, and account information.

Does ABC Glofox support memberships and payments?

Yes. ABC Glofox supports recurring memberships, credit packs, flexible billing, stored payment
details, failed payment handling, receipts, account balances, and advanced payment management.

Does ABC Glofox help with marketing and retention?

Yes. ABC Glofox includes automated messaging, nurture journeys, segmentation, and email, SMS, and
push communication tools to help engage leads, retain members, and support stronger business growth.

Can ABC Glofox support multi-location fitness businesses?

Yes. ABC Glofox includes multi-location capabilities that help operators manage locations more
efficiently, centralize reporting, and support member experiences across sites.

customizable web experience that delivers a premium, on-brand experience.

### Billing & Payments

Simplify how you get paid with built-in payments, flexible billing, POS tools, cardless in-app
purchases, and automated handling of failed payments, balances, and receipts.

### CRM

Drive growth with built-in marketing tools and automated messaging across email, SMS, and push, from
promotions and reminders to full member journeys that keep members engaged and coming back.

controls, and integrated door entry.

instructor performance—all in one place.

staff connected and empowers them to deliver great member experiences in class and on the floor.

Support for fitness businesses of any size, from single locations to global operations, with
multi-region capabilities and flexible models including royalty structures.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is gym management software?

Gym management software helps fitness businesses manage bookings, memberships, payments, member
communication, and reporting in one connected platform. ABC Glofox is designed to help studios and
gyms simplify operations and grow revenue faster.

Who is ABC Glofox built for?

ABC Glofox is built for fitness studios and gyms, from startups to scaled international franchises.
It supports a wide range of fitness businesses, including yoga, Pilates, boxing, HIIT, PT, and
multi-location operators.

Can members book classes and manage their accounts online?

Yes. Members can book classes, appointments, and other services through the member app and web
portal, while also managing payment details, memberships, and account information.

Does ABC Glofox support memberships and payments?

Yes. ABC Glofox supports recurring memberships, credit packs, flexible billing, stored payment
details, failed payment handling, receipts, account balances, and advanced payment management.

Does ABC Glofox help with marketing and retention?

Yes. ABC Glofox includes automated messaging, nurture journeys, segmentation, and email, SMS, and
push communication tools to help engage leads, retain members, and support stronger business growth.

Can ABC Glofox support multi-location fitness businesses?

Yes. ABC Glofox includes multi-location capabilities that help operators manage locations more
efficiently, centralize reporting, and support member experiences across sites.

### Frequently asked questions

### How does the free trial work?

Our 14 day trial is 100% free and does not require any credit card information to start. If at the
end of your trial you would like to upgrade, great. If not, your plan will automatically be
downgraded to the free plan.

### Do I need to choose a plan now?

No. You get the full featured, unlimited version of our service completely free for 14 days. Once
you're ready to upgrade, you may choose a plan which suits your needs.

### Can I switch plans later?

Absolutely. You can switch between our paid plans, or cancel your account altogether, whenever you
like. We will adjust any payments accordingly.

### What payment types do you accept?

We accept payments from MasterCard, Visa, Visa Debit, American Express and PayPal. Remember, you do
not need to supply card details to start your free trial.

### Do you have any contracts or cancellation fees?

No. Appointy is a pay-as-you-go service. We do not have contracts or cancellation fees. You can
cancel whenever you want. If you cancel, you’ll be billed for the current month, but you won’t be
billed again.

### Who owns my data?

You do! It's your data after all! We want customers to use Appointy because they love it, not
because their data is stuck in it. You can export all of your information from Appointy at any time,
no matter what plan you choose.

### Have any other questions?

If you have questions about Appointy or the sign up process, please email us at
[contact@appointy.com][51] and we will be glad to answer all your questions!

No. You get the full featured, unlimited version of our service completely free for 14 days. Once
you're ready to upgrade, you may choose a plan which suits your needs.

Absolutely. You can switch between our paid plans, or cancel your account altogether, whenever you
like. We will adjust any payments accordingly.

cancel whenever you want. If you cancel, you’ll be billed for the current month, but you won’t be

because their data is stuck in it. You can export all of your information from Appointy at any time,

## Personal Service: the AptusSoft Difference

AptusSoft offers a most comprehensive, integrated package of club management software and service.
AptusSoft connects every aspect of club operations, including front-desk, HR, marketing, scheduling,
and security, helping you to save money and optimize all of your resources – membership, staff and
facilities.

With more than two decades experience working closely with hundreds of clubs in the US, we know this
is a business built around people – it’s why we focus so much on personal service.
* Save Time and Money
* Get More out of Club Resources
* Increase Member Satisfaction and Value
* We’ll meet with your staff to understand your club’s unique needs.
* As needed, we’ll fine-tune our software to fit your operations.
* Every installation includes extensive personal training.
* Our top people will be there for you whenever you have questions.
* We’ll build new features that take advantage of technology and club best practices.

Our flagship product, **Enterprise Club and Activity Management System (ECMS), is designed to
realize the potential of integrated data working through state-of-the-art software systems. ECMS**
offers a complete suite of modules designed to help you manage all aspects of your business:
* Annual planning
* Billing and collections
* Staff and facility optimization
* Member acquisition, upgrades and retention

## Smart check-in

The front desk is your primary point of contact with members. It’s where you greet and log them in,
schedule classes, trainings and court time, answer questions, and suggest service upgrades. To make
the most of this contact, we’ve designed our check-in module to put extensive member and scheduling
data at the fingertips of your front-desk staff. Our check-in module includes such features as:
* Rapid, multi-mode check-in
* Member preferences, usage and account status
* Member schedules
* One-click check-in for families

## Robust membership prospecting

Your club’s business health depends on successful prospecting—you need a constant flow of prospects
in the pipeline with a high close rate for your revenue and profitability to grow. We designed our
sales module to make it easy for you to monitor your prospecting activities and the performance of
your sales staff. Our prospecting and sales module includes features like:
* Comprehensive lead-to-close prospect monitoring
* Detailed data capture on prospect interests
* Complete log of sales calls and follow-up activities
* Tracking and management of free promotional passes

## On-line member services

In today’s digital-first world, more and more members prefer on-line self-service. To help you meet
the digital preferences of your members, we’ve designed our software to allow you to offer a full
array of on-line services, including:
* Start-to-finish membership purchase on-line, including site tours, membership selection, contract
  signature, and payment set-up
* Schedule review and class, training and court-time booking
* Account review and payment
* Health tracking

## Comprehensive data access and reporting

One of the most powerful benefits of AptusSoft is having access to all aspects of your club through
one integrated system. Because every action in your club, from prospecting to member check-in,
facility usage, purchases and payments are recorded in the same database, you can review their
current status, as well as track over time and by facility, department, and individual staff member.
With AptusSoft you can generate a host of reports, using the filters and format you want, such as:
* Daily POS reconciliation
* AR aging management, including real-time charts
* Sales and marketing campaign tracking
* Resource/facility revenue optimization
* Grid-based inventory management

##### Asana Work Graph®[chevron-up icon]

A neural network of everything your company is doing, every person, task, project, goal, and
dependency connected, so humans and agents always know who is doing what, by when, and toward which
goal.

[Network diagram showing Asana's connected work graph with Goals, Portfolios, Projects, Tickets, and

##### Multiplayer[chevron-up icon]

Every workflow, app, and agent runs in a shared space where humans and agents act on the same plan,
see the same context, and get smarter with every interaction. Multiple humans can train, guide, and
improve any agent.

[Asana task comments showing a conversation between teammates and Beacon AI, which retrieves task

Shared memory means AI Teammates learn from the work itself. Every completed task, every piece of
feedback, every preference gets carried forward, so no one repeats context they've already given and
every workflow starts smarter than the last.

profile showing its memory log with learned preferences for pricing communications, confidence
scoring, and deal-level recommendations]

Every agent has an identity, scoped permissions, an audit trail, and cost constraints, with data
access, approved actions, and spend all managed from the same console that governs human users.

Manage all aspects of your golf club from with ease, from any location thanks to the new ClubV1
Admin app which is available free of charge to all ClubV1 users.

You’ll get access to all of the same features as usual, from membership to billing and competition
management, in a new-look design which is specifically suited to phones and tablets, making it
easier than ever to access the UK&I's leading golf club management solution.

EPoS and web services such as HowDidiDo, Golfingindex and personalised club websites.

More than 2000 Golf Clubs in the UK and Ireland along with customers as far afield as Kenya, Bahrain
and Sri Lanka have now installed one or more of our packages, thanks to them, we have grown to lead
the Golf Club market.

Our current, ClubV1 Hosted solution, is the most widely used 'on-line' system in UK & Irish golf.
Through our commitment to continuous development, users and members are able to experience the very
best features that technology can deliver. Administer your club on almost any device, from almost
anywhere with an Internet connection.

Every customer, from Disley Golf Club (top picture), to The Royal and Ancient Golf Club of St.

Manage all aspects of your golf club from with ease, from any location thanks to the new ClubV1
Admin app which is available free of charge to all ClubV1 users.

You’ll get access to all of the same features as usual, from membership to billing and competition
management, in a new-look design which is specifically suited to phones and tablets, making it
easier than ever to access the UK&I's leading golf club management solution.

## About Us

Established in 1982, Club Systems started with a simple CONGU Golf Handicapping Solution.  Designed
originally for our founder's (Keith Roberts) own golf club, Disley in Cheshire.

All these years later we are also the market leaders in Member and visitor Administration, Loyalty
EPoS and web services such as HowDidiDo, Golfingindex and personalised club websites.

More than 2000 Golf Clubs in the UK and Ireland along with customers as far afield as Kenya, Bahrain
and Sri Lanka have now installed one or more of our packages, thanks to them, we have grown to lead
the Golf Club market.

Our current, ClubV1 Hosted solution, is the most widely used 'on-line' system in UK & Irish golf.
Through our commitment to continuous development, users and members are able to experience the very
best features that technology can deliver. Administer your club on almost any device, from almost
anywhere with an Internet connection.

Every customer, from Disley Golf Club (top picture), to The Royal and Ancient Golf Club of St.
Andrews, not only receives 7 day a week support via telephone, email or live chat but also on site
assistance from a team of on the road professionals dedicated to excellent customer service and the
best tailored solutions the industry has to offer.

In September 2022, Club Systems International and HowDidiDo Media became part of the ClearCourse
Group.

[About Us image][About Us image]

## Part of ClearCourse

Club Systems is proudly part of ClearCourse – a UK-based technology group that provides software and
payments for small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), including start-ups, national retailers, many
of the best-known charities, and notable brands across various sectors.

The group has a mission to build brilliant businesses by integrating the best software, payments,
services and people, and we believe that by being part of ClearCourse, we can continue to scale and
grow our business, and ultimately keep improving our software for you.

Being part of a larger group brings several benefits to our business – and our customers, too.

As we are part of a larger group of software and payments platforms, we can tap into the knowledge
and experience of our fellow ClearCourse businesses.

If there’s a chance to integrate our software to offer a better solution, we’ll take it. If there’s
the opportunity to work strategically with them to enhance what we can offer you, we’ll do so.

A perfect example of this in action is ClearAccept, a range of payment solutions purpose built for
ClearCourse software solutions like Club Systems

Their range of payment products mean that our clients can now get their software and payments
solutions from one organisation, and we’ll help you future-proof your payments by continuing to
evolve based on your feedback and the sector’s needs.

From a growth and stability perspective, being part of ClearCourse means we’re backed financially,
so we can continue to invest in and develop our platform.

We can also tap into learnings from many other ClearCourse businesses working in the Charity and
Commercial sector – meaning our platform will always evolve to ensure it’s as relevant as possible
for you.

To learn more about ClearCourse, our brands, our ethos and our work, [check out our website.][46]

## End-to-End. Built for Integrators. Proven at Scale.

D-Tools provides seamless, end-to-end solutions to manage every aspect of your integration workflow.
From client engagement and project planning to installation and service, D-Tools connects proposals,
resource management, and customer success into one streamlined platform.

Empowering efficiency and innovation, D-Tools frees your team to focus on delivering exceptional
results. It’s more than software—it’s the catalyst driving growth, transformation, and success in
your business.

[circle_web]

## Every Stage of Your Workflow, in One Platform

personalized proposals. Generate precise quotes featuring integrator-specific pricing, elevating
your efficiency and delivering a seamless experience to your clients. Leverage precise estimating
capabilities to guarantee accurate project assessments from start to finish.

Product Library for highly accurate and detailed documentation.

Deliver your projects on time and on budget. Manage project workflows, from initial design through
installation, with a detailed change order and management process. Gantt charts, task tracking and
scheduling tools streamline workflows and effectively manage installations, service orders, and job
costing. Schedule and dispatch field technicians to ensure installation tasks are completed
efficiently.

plans, or efficiently manage one-off service requests, ensuring smooth operations and long-term
client relationships.

Optimize your proposals and system designs with D-Tools’ integrated product library—featuring 1.6
million products from over 1,200 brands, complete with integrator-level pricing. Simplify catalog
management to reduce data entry time and help ensure accurate pricing on every project. More than

# Dilijani Tun Hotel,
# Dilijan

[Hotel management software][33]

## Genuine sophistication, spectacular views

A true gem, Dilijani Tun looks out over Dilijan, which is found in one of the most beautiful regions
of Armenia – the Tavush. From its top, Dilijani Tun sits between the mountains and the horizon,
looking out over the landscape below.
The house has large garden designed for guests to immerse themselves in the beauty of the nature.
Look past the dry-stone walls to the exotic and authentic Armenian trees. Everything has been
designed to preserve and enhance the authenticity of the place.

[Hotel management software][34]
[Hotel management software][35]

## Generous and
## personalized service

Dilijani Tun is run by a generous and caring staff who make every moment unforgettable. No detail is
left untouched and the team will do everything possible to ensure guests can immerse themselves in a
warm and intimate atmosphere. The team at Dilijani Tun hopes everyone who steps through the door
will hold onto memories of a place that is filled with moments of surprise and delight – for the
young and old, families, friends and couples.

## Rooms, suites & cottages

Rooms are arguably the most important part of any hotel. They are, after all, where guests spend
most of their time. And yet room descriptions on hotel websites are so often focus on the dull
stuff: lists of facilities, floor area, aspect, types of bed, amenities…
You need those things too, of course, to decide which room to book. But they don’t answer the
question of what awaits when you turn the key in the door.

## Genuine sophistication, spectacular views

A true gem, Dilijani Tun looks out over Dilijan, which is found in one of the most beautiful regions
of Armenia – the Tavush. From its top, Dilijani Tun sits between the mountains and the horizon,
looking out over the landscape below.
The house has large garden designed for guests to immerse themselves in the beauty of the nature.
Look past the dry-stone walls to the exotic and authentic Armenian trees. Everything has been
designed to preserve and enhance the authenticity of the place.

## Generous and
## personalized service

Dilijani Tun is run by a generous and caring staff who make every moment unforgettable. No detail is
left untouched and the team will do everything possible to ensure guests can immerse themselves in a
warm and intimate atmosphere. The team at Dilijani Tun hopes everyone who steps through the door
will hold onto memories of a place that is filled with moments of surprise and delight – for the
young and old, families, friends and couples.

## Rooms, suites & cottages

Rooms are arguably the most important part of any hotel. They are, after all, where guests spend
most of their time. And yet room descriptions on hotel websites are so often focus on the dull
stuff: lists of facilities, floor area, aspect, types of bed, amenities…
You need those things too, of course, to decide which room to book. But they don’t answer the

regulatory pressure make compliance and risk management increasingly difficult. Without a
*centralized platform*, critical information stays siloed and risk grows.

DiliTrust is the only AI-native platform that simplifies every dimension of legal work, replacing
fragmented tools with one connected suite for legal operations and corporate governance.

### **Board portal for modern governance**

The DiliTrust Board Portal supports every stage of board governance — from preparing agendas and
sharing documents to managing votes and generating automatic minutes. As dedicated *board management
software*, it keeps directors and corporate secretaries working in one secure environment, making
*board meetings* structured and productive.

[**Discover More**][143]

showcase the benefits of the features, ]

### ****Full visibility across your contract lifecycle****

Managing contracts without proper control creates compliance gaps and missed obligations. DiliTrust
Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) centralizes every phase — from drafting to renewal — with
automated workflows, AI-powered risk detection, and a clear view of every commitment in real time.

[**Discover More**][144]
[Contract wireframe for showcase the benefits of the features, ][Contract wireframe for showcase the
benefits of the features, ]

### **Centralized control of your legal entities**

For organizations managing multiple entities across jurisdictions, governance data quickly becomes
fragmented. DiliTrust Entity Management gives legal teams, directors, and compliance officers a
real-time view of the entire corporate structure — supporting informed decisions, transparency, and
full regulatory control across the group.

[**Discover More**][145]
[Entities wireframe for showcase the benefits of the features,][Entities wireframe for showcase the
benefits of the features,]

### **Clear oversight of your legal matters**

As legal workloads grow, maintaining supervision over governance matters, timelines, and outside
counsel spend becomes critical. DiliTrust Matter Management is a legal operations platform where
teams track every matter from intake to resolution — with automated workflows and full visibility
for all stakeholders.

[**Discover More**][146]
[Wireframe of Matter Management,][Wireframe of Matter Management,]

### **Secure sharing of your most sensitive documents**

Sensitive legal documents require protection, traceability, and access limited to authorized
parties. DiliTrust Dataroom provides a cloud-based, *centralized platform* where documents are
stored securely, organized with granular access controls, and shared internally or externally with

### **Board portal for modern governance**

The DiliTrust Board Portal supports every stage of board governance — from preparing agendas and
sharing documents to managing votes and generating automatic minutes. As dedicated *board management
software*, it keeps directors and corporate secretaries working in one secure environment, making
*board meetings* structured and productive.

[**Discover More**][143]

### ****Full visibility across your contract lifecycle****

Managing contracts without proper control creates compliance gaps and missed obligations. DiliTrust
Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) centralizes every phase — from drafting to renewal — with
automated workflows, AI-powered risk detection, and a clear view of every commitment in real time.

[**Discover More**][144]
[Contract wireframe for showcase the benefits of the features, ][Contract wireframe for showcase the
benefits of the features, ]

### **Centralized control of your legal entities**

For organizations managing multiple entities across jurisdictions, governance data quickly becomes
fragmented. DiliTrust Entity Management gives legal teams, directors, and compliance officers a
real-time view of the entire corporate structure — supporting informed decisions, transparency, and
full regulatory control across the group.

[**Discover More**][145]
[Entities wireframe for showcase the benefits of the features,][Entities wireframe for showcase the
benefits of the features,]

### **Clear oversight of your legal matters**

As legal workloads grow, maintaining supervision over governance matters, timelines, and outside
counsel spend becomes critical. DiliTrust Matter Management is a legal operations platform where
teams track every matter from intake to resolution — with automated workflows and full visibility
for all stakeholders.

[**Discover More**][146]
[Wireframe of Matter Management,][Wireframe of Matter Management,]

### **Secure sharing of your most sensitive documents**

Sensitive legal documents require protection, traceability, and access limited to authorized
parties. DiliTrust Dataroom provides a cloud-based, *centralized platform* where documents are
stored securely, organized with granular access controls, and shared internally or externally with
complete audit trails.

retention, and more sign-ups.

designed as a low-cost and reliable way to provide access control for your members. [Find out

Bring every process, team, and decision into one intelligent ecosystem designed to optimize,
execute, and outperform continuously.

Natural language becomes your interface. No more digging through menus or navigating complex pages.
Just say what you need, and it gets done.

Hashy, how is our cash flow this month?

**92% of target** with 3 weeks left — pipeline coverage needs a push.

Step-by-Step

## Get Started in Minutes, Not Hours

No complex setup, no IT department needed. Most coaches expect a weekend of setup with new systems.
With Striveon, you'll be running organized practices by Monday.

1.

### Sign Up

[Create your free account(opens in new tab)][17] and experience what organized coaching feels like.
Setup takes under 10 minutes with our interactive guides.

2.

### Build Your Teams

Bring your roster in from a file or paste it straight in, and Striveon sets up your season around
your real players. Recurring sessions appear on everyone's calendar automatically. Your team
structure is ready, so start planning your first session.

3.

### Coach Like the Professional You Are

Do what you love: develop athletes and create breakthrough moments. Never waste another Sunday
recreating schedules.

Transparent Pricing

## No Hidden Fees. No Ads. No Surprises.

Unlike other platforms that charge per coach or per athlete, Striveon has one simple price for your
entire organization. Add new members as your team grows - your price stays exactly the same.

One simple flat rate

€49/mo

Plus VAT where applicable

Unlimited coaches and athletes, every feature included

[Start Your Free Trial][18]
[See full pricing details →][19]
FAQ

## Questions from Coaches Like You

Common questions from coaches exploring Striveon

### What if I'm not tech-savvy?

Striveon is built to be intuitive, even for non-technical users. With interactive guides, sample
data, and a clean design, you'll be up and running in minutes.

### What if I only have a few athletes?

Striveon works just as well for 5 athletes as for 500. You get every feature at a flat rate, the
same professional tools whether you're coaching a small group or a full academy.

### Can I bring my existing roster?

Yes. During onboarding you can import your roster from a CSV or Excel file, or paste it in as text.
Striveon maps the columns, shows a preview before anything is created, and sets up your season
around your real players. Your existing roster is in and organized within minutes.

### How is Striveon different from club admin tools?

Registration, scheduling, and payment tools tell you who is in your club. Striveon covers the side
they leave blank: the coaching itself. Season plans, drills, evaluations, and progress charts live
in one place and show whether every athlete is actually developing.

### Can I use it with multiple teams?

Yes! Striveon is designed for multi-team coordination. You can manage all your groups, schedules,
and communications in one place without losing clarity.

### Can my assistant coaches access it too?

For sure, your flat-rate subscription covers every coach in your organization. A new assistant coach
instantly sees your drill library, athlete assessments, notes, and season plans. No need to dig
through scattered files or start from scratch.

### What devices do I need to use it?

No installations required. Striveon runs in your browser on desktops, tablets, and phones. Chrome is
recommended for the best experience, but any modern browser works.

## Questions from Coaches Like You

Common questions from coaches exploring Striveon

### What if I'm not tech-savvy?

Striveon is built to be intuitive, even for non-technical users. With interactive guides, sample
data, and a clean design, you'll be up and running in minutes.

### What if I only have a few athletes?

Striveon works just as well for 5 athletes as for 500. You get every feature at a flat rate, the
same professional tools whether you're coaching a small group or a full academy.

### Can I bring my existing roster?

Yes. During onboarding you can import your roster from a CSV or Excel file, or paste it in as text.
Striveon maps the columns, shows a preview before anything is created, and sets up your season
around your real players. Your existing roster is in and organized within minutes.

### How is Striveon different from club admin tools?

Registration, scheduling, and payment tools tell you who is in your club. Striveon covers the side
they leave blank: the coaching itself. Season plans, drills, evaluations, and progress charts live
in one place and show whether every athlete is actually developing.

### Can I use it with multiple teams?

Yes! Striveon is designed for multi-team coordination. You can manage all your groups, schedules,
and communications in one place without losing clarity.

### Can my assistant coaches access it too?

For sure, your flat-rate subscription covers every coach in your organization. A new assistant coach
instantly sees your drill library, athlete assessments, notes, and season plans. No need to dig
through scattered files or start from scratch.

### What devices do I need to use it?

No installations required. Striveon runs in your browser on desktops, tablets, and phones. Chrome is
recommended for the best experience, but any modern browser works.

#### Exceptional experiences start with your service team.

### **Mobile POS**

The Mobile POS brings your stationary POS terminal to Android and iOS devices and allows you to
create a personalized shopping experience for members through a user-friendly interface. Take orders
and manage chits on the go even when Wi-Fi or Data connection is lost. The Mobile POS supports
credit card payments through integration with Stripe.

[LEARN MORE][126]


#### Dining Reservations

Create a seamless dining experience for your members. From reservation to payment, all are handled
accurately thanks to the deep integration with the Point of Sale.



#### Tee Time Management

The all-in-one solution for golf management allows members to book their tee time easily and
personalize their experience. Integrated with your Point of Sale, it makes managing chits and fees
effortless.



#### Appointment Booking

Appointment Booking is an integrated suite of back office, online, and mobile products, which work
together to enable your staff and service providers to set their schedules, giving them a new way to
interact with your members.

 



#### Activity Tracking

With our Activity Tracking application, you can have attendants check a member in, let members check
themselves in, or provide an automatic check in by using the club mobile app and beacon technology.

 



#### Club Accounting

We understand your business and provide the necessary tools to allow your team to easily track and
report on all transactions within your facility – from member spending in a restaurant to the
payable history of a particular vendor.

 



#### Event Management

The Event Management application quickly and efficiently manages room configurations, scheduling,
equipment, and a full range of services, resulting in a streamlined booking process and worry-free
events at your club.

## Discover our flagship product

## Member Management Software

## Compete Member Management Software is

## The heart of your Facility

Compete is a comprehensive, easy-to-use membership management platform created to support your
unique business needs and offer your members an intuitive online member experience. It has
everything you need to run a successful business, all in one place.
* Expand your functionality with native browser-based add-ons
* Collect more revenue with Member Billing Services
* Integrate our software with your favorite solutions
* Secure member data with PCI P2PE Compliant software
* Rest easy with 99.9% system uptime

[See Compete in Action][159]

## Take Compete to another level with

## Browser-based modules

Expand Compete’s functionalities to every aspect of your operational needs. With our suite of
browser-based module solutions, you can transform your club’s operations, streamline member
enrollment, and increase member retention. Our software can help clubs at every step of the member
journey.
* Sign members up with **Join Online**
* Let members manage their accounts with **Empower ME**
* Take your front desk anywhere with ** Compete on the Go**
* Empower your staff with **Employee Self Service**

## Integrate your favorite solutions with our

## Channel Partner Ecosystem

We partner with the industry’s best software companies via our open API. With a network of over 30
integrations, our software provides a hub for all connected software solutions. Do you need a custom
mobile app solution and door access? How about email marketing and a fully integrated CRM? Compete’s
Channel Partner Ecosystem has you covered.
* Seamless integration with Compete
* More than 1000 integration possibilities

[Learn More][160]

## Software with integrated

## Payment Processing

Jonas Fitness offers EFT and point of sale payment processing options to give your facility more
flexibility. Our established history, coupled with our commitment to innovation, has bred
best-in-class payment solutions that seamlessly integrate with our Compete Member Management
Software and ecosystem.
* Improved Security: Validated P2PE Compliant
* Reduce your PCI Scope by 85%
* As a Payment Facilitator, we offer competitive rates
* Native POS statements in Compete
* Card Account Updater

## Collect more revenue with

## Member Billing Services

You didn’t get into the fitness business to worry about billing. That’s okay. We’re here to help.
Our Member Billing Services is a customizable one-stop shop for all your billing-related needs
created to simplify your life. Leverage our industry-leading techniques and best practices to
optimize your process, which in turn saves you time, increases collections, and unlocks revenue.
* 1-800 call center services
* Automated collection services
* Real-time reporting

[Learn More][161]

## acquisition stories

“The Jonas family of companies was a great permanent home for our family business. It was clear from
the beginning that Jonas shares our belief of taking great care of our employees and customers. They
stand behind their ‘Software for Life’ promise.”

**John Brookbank**
*Shareholder & CEO, BEC Legal*

“I joined Jonas through the acquisition of XN Leisure in 2010. Not only has the business thrived
under Jonas ownership, it has also been a fantastic place for me to grow my career.”

**Darrell Boxall**
*Managing Director, XN Leisure (now Portfolio Manager, Jonas UK)*

“One of Jonas’ key success factors is autonomy and decentralization. Since selling my software
company to Jonas in 2012, I’ve continued to run my business independently while being able to tap
into the knowledge and best practices from other Jonas companies.”

**Eric Rennagel**
*Founder & CEO, My Media Box*

“We had the autonomy to keep our beautiful staff and maintain our culture. But we also got to become
part of a bigger Jonas family that would support us and help us grow even more. This is why we
believed Jonas was a great fit for us at Shortcuts.”

**Jo Burgess**
*Co-Founder & VP, Shortcuts*

“You spend all this time building your baby and you really care about the future of your business
and what is going to happen to it. We knew Jonas cared as much about the long term future of
EZFacility as we did.”

**Eric Willin**
*Former CEO, EZFacility (Current Portfolio Manager, Jonas)*

scheduling platform and more. The software helps the members to inquire, apply and pay online. It
also sends automated push notifications directly to the phone to keep the members updated. You need

Running a club takes passion, time, and constant effort – but with NEST, **everything you need is
all in one place.** Our all-in-one solution combines cutting-edge club management software, reliable
fee collection and expert business support to help you run and grow your club with confidence. 

For **over 25 years** we have been trusted by **over 7,000 club owners**, helping them support
**thousands of members,** streamline operations and achieve sustainable growth. Whether you’re
building a new club, growing your membership, or managing multiple locations, NEST provides the
tools, technology, and expertise to support **every stage of your journey.**

From automated communication and website design to marketing and business growth strategies, we help
club owners save time, reduce admin, and focus on what matters most – **building a thriving
community.**

**Stop juggling providers and partner with NEST to take your club to the next level.**

## TAILORED TO EVERY CLUB

### Established
* Simplified membership and fee management tools
* Marketing and website services to boost visibility
* Support with administrative tasks to reduce workload
* Business sustainability guidance for long-term impact

[ find out more ][168]

### Franchise
* Centralised management tools for multiple locations
* Unified brand and member tracking across all branches
* Expert franchise business support for operational consistency
* Scalable expert solutions for growth and expansion

[ find out more ][169]

### COMMUNITY
* Reduce admin and workload to focus on members
* Events system to create, manage and execute fundraising events
* Safeguarding training for all your club members
* Email and SMS to stay connected to your community

[ find out more ][170]

### Start Ups
* Step-by-step guidance to launch and grow quickly
* Marketing toolkit and lead-generating website to attract members
* Secure Direct Debit fee collection for stable cash flow
* Business and Marketing consultancy for long-term success

[ find out more ][171]

Choosing the right partner to support your club’s growth is an important decision. At NEST, we make
it simple with a transparent, supportive, and tailored approach built around helping clubs succeed.
From day one, you gain access to our complete all-in-one solution – including club management
software, fee collection, marketing support, websites, communication tools, and expert business
consultancy.

**No hidden costs, just genuine value and ongoing support.**

Whether you’re launching your first club, growing your membership, or managing multiple locations,
our experienced team works alongside you to help achieve your goals while reducing the stress of
running a business. By simplifying the day-to-day operations, we give club owners more time to focus
on what matters most – their members, their community, and the passion behind their club.

**Partner with NEST and build a stronger, more sustainable future for your club and the people
within it.**

## LEADING THE WAY WITH US

David Trower at Evolution Taekwondo

“Their impact on our business has been nothing short of incredible. From handling our billing
seamlessly to providing invaluable management solutions, they have truly been a game-changer for our
academy.”

Lee Nash at Adrenaline Martial Arts

“They are always on hand to offer guidance and support on everything from customer service, budget
planning to marketing and promotion.”

Amanda Saunders at Teach Me Kung Fu

“They truly care about their clients and invest a lot of time, effort and money in providing systems
and other support to enable us to run our martial arts school effectively.”

### OUR LATEST NEWS

#### FREE Online Webinar: **From Enquiry to Membership**

*Stop losing great prospects and start building long-term students*

Getting enquiries feels good. Losing them quietly does not.

Many martial arts clubs struggle not with lead generation, but with what happens next. Messages go
unanswered, follow-up feels awkward, and prospects disappear after the first class with no clear
reason why.

This webinar looks at the full journey from first enquiry to long-term membership. We’ll break down
what prospects actually expect, how trust is built early on, and where small gaps in follow-up are
costing you sign-ups and retention.

You’ll hear from **Simon and Christine Walker**, owners of **Phoenix Martial Arts**, recognised for
being among the best in the business when it comes to getting and keeping students.

If you want a clearer, more reliable way to turn interest into committed members, this session will
help.

## Key Features of Billing & Accounting Software
* Inventory Management
* Accounting Management
* GST Billing
* Live Sales Tracking
* Cash Management
* You can easily monitor and manage your product stock, ensuring you never run out of essential
  items with our inventory management software.
* Our billing software helps track stock levels in real-time, reducing the risk of overstocking or
  running out of items during peak business hours.
* Automatically update your inventory with every sale or purchase, without the need for manual
  entries or stock count adjustments.
* Our system allows you to manage products with batch numbers, expiry dates, and MRP, making it
  perfect for grocery stores, medical shops, and retail outlets.
* You can transfer stock between multiple branches or locations with a few clicks, and the system
  automatically generates movement reports.
* It simplifies bulk purchase management, returns, and damaged stock tracking so that you always
  have a clear picture of your inventory.
* With our billing software, you can also set stock alerts, manage reordering, and maintain an
  accurate record of all inventory movement from one place.
* It simplifies handling all financial activities by automating journal entries, ledgers, and
  balance sheets, saving time and reducing manual errors.
* With our accounting management system, you can easily manage all your business transactions in one
  place without needing separate accounting software.
* It helps automatically record sales, purchases, expenses, and payments so that your financial
  books stay accurate and always up to date.
* The software also matches your bank statements with business transactions, making bank
  reconciliation simple and reducing mismatches.
* It allows you to check pending payments and receivables instantly, helping you send reminders and
  improve overall cash flow.
* You can generate GST reports, profit-loss statements, and audit-ready reports in one click,
  perfect for tax filing and financial reviews.
* All your financial data is stored safely and can be backed up or exported in multiple formats like
  Excel or PDF for easy sharing.
* Our billing software helps you generate GST-compliant invoices quickly and accurately without any
  manual calculation.
* It supports all GST types including CGST, SGST, IGST, and automatically applies the correct tax
  based on customer location.
* You can easily create invoices with HSN/SAC codes, GST rates, and customer GSTIN details to ensure
  100% compliance.
* The system allows you to create B2B and B2C invoices, generate credit or debit notes, and handle
  returns with GST adjustments.
* It provides ready-to-download GST reports like GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and sales summaries that you can
  directly share with your CA or upload on the GST portal.
* Invoices can be printed or shared via email/WhatsApp in multiple formats such as thermal receipts,
  A4, or custom layouts.
* All billing data is securely stored and can be backed up anytime, giving you full control and
  confidence during audits or tax filing.
* Our billing software allows you to monitor every sale in real-time, helping you stay updated with
  your business performance every second.
* You can check how much revenue is generated, which products are selling the most, and how each
  outlet or counter is performing live.
* Even if you’re not present at the store, you can track live sales from your mobile or laptop from
  anywhere at any time.
* The system automatically refreshes data as transactions happen, so you always see the latest sales
  figures without delay.
* You can filter reports by date, time, cashier, item, or location to understand your sales trends
  and customer preferences more clearly.
* This helps you make faster decisions, like restocking hot-selling items or adjusting offers, to
  increase daily sales and customer satisfaction.
* Live tracking also boosts team performance, as you can see which staff member is selling what,
  helping you plan rewards or training accordingly.
* Our billing software helps you manage all your cash transactions accurately, whether it’s cash-in
  from sales or cash-out for expenses.
* You can track every rupee that enters or leaves your cash counter in real-time, reducing chances
  of manual errors or theft.
* The system records petty cash expenses, daily cash collections, and staff payouts — all in one
  place, with full transparency.
* Cash register summaries can be generated anytime during or after business hours, showing opening
  balance, total sales, and closing balance.
* You can also manage multiple cash drawers or counters across branches, and the system tracks who
  handled which transaction.
* It becomes easy to verify cash at the end of the day, and any mismatch is quickly identified with
  clear reporting.
* All your cash-related data is stored securely and can be exported or printed as daily cash reports
  for auditing or internal records.

  Excel or PDF for easy sharing.

  handled which transaction.

  clear reporting.

Experience Heritage, Luxury & Exclusivity

# The Secunderabad Club

Since 1878, Secunderabad Club has been a hub of tradition, recreation, and camaraderie.
[Explore More][54]

## About Us

A Legacy of Excellence

Established by The British in 1878, The Secunderabad Club is one of the oldest clubs in India. The
Club’s century-old Main Club House, that is carefully and aesthetically maintained, is given a
heritage building status by the Hyderabad Urban Development Authority.

[ Know More ][55]
[Slide Image]
[Slide Image]

### Facilities & Services

#### World Class Amenities for a Premium Experience

FACILITIES

#### FACILITIES

The Club offers many utility facilities for the members such as the main library, a salon for women
and men separately, children’s lounge, laundry and more.

[Read More][56]
Sports & Fitness

#### Sports & Fitness

There are many indoor and outdoor sports options for the club members. The sports arenas are buzzing
with activity in the mornings and evenings where members meet in the good spirit of sportsmanship
and camaraderie.

[Read More][57]
Accomodation

#### Accomodation

The Club has about 35 rooms for overnight accommodation of guests for renting at very reasonable
tariff. All the rooms are completely renovated by providing the latest bath fittings, shower
cubicles and new upholstery.

[Read More][58]
Dining

#### Dining

The Club is popular for it’s outstanding food. Many dining options are available at the club
including the Main Dining hall, Mixed Lounge, Ashoka Bay, Fountain Lawns, and Main Lawns.

[Read More][59]
Banquets

#### Banquets

The Club has 7 banqueting halls that may be reserved by members for private parties. From the
magnificent Samantik Hall to the elegant Kakatiya and East Lawns, from the intimate Committee
Chambers to the 1878 Bar.

[Read More][60]
Bars

#### Bars

The Club has many bar options for the members and their guests to choose from. These include the
Fountain Bar, Umbrella Bar, Ashoka Bay Bar and soon to open is the Colonnade.

[Read More][61]

###### At The Hussain Sagar Lakeside

#### SAILING ANNEXE

The Secunderabad Club Sailing Annex offers an exceptional sailing experience on the pristine waters
of Hussain Sagar Lake . With state of the art boats and expert trainers , members can enjoy
recreational sailing or participate in competitive regattas .

[Explore More][62]

# The Secunderabad Club

Since 1878, Secunderabad Club has been a hub of tradition, recreation, and camaraderie.
[Explore More][54]

## About Us

A Legacy of Excellence

Established by The British in 1878, The Secunderabad Club is one of the oldest clubs in India. The
Club’s century-old Main Club House, that is carefully and aesthetically maintained, is given a
heritage building status by the Hyderabad Urban Development Authority.

[ Know More ][55]
[Slide Image]
[Slide Image]

### Facilities & Services

#### World Class Amenities for a Premium Experience

FACILITIES

#### FACILITIES

The Club offers many utility facilities for the members such as the main library, a salon for women
and men separately, children’s lounge, laundry and more.

[Read More][56]
Sports & Fitness

#### Sports & Fitness

There are many indoor and outdoor sports options for the club members. The sports arenas are buzzing
with activity in the mornings and evenings where members meet in the good spirit of sportsmanship
and camaraderie.

[Read More][57]
Accomodation

#### Accomodation

The Club has about 35 rooms for overnight accommodation of guests for renting at very reasonable
tariff. All the rooms are completely renovated by providing the latest bath fittings, shower
cubicles and new upholstery.

[Read More][58]
Dining

#### Dining

The Club is popular for it’s outstanding food. Many dining options are available at the club
including the Main Dining hall, Mixed Lounge, Ashoka Bay, Fountain Lawns, and Main Lawns.

[Read More][59]
Banquets

#### Banquets

The Club has 7 banqueting halls that may be reserved by members for private parties. From the
magnificent Samantik Hall to the elegant Kakatiya and East Lawns, from the intimate Committee
Chambers to the 1878 Bar.

[Read More][60]
Bars

#### Bars

The Club has many bar options for the members and their guests to choose from. These include the
Fountain Bar, Umbrella Bar, Ashoka Bay Bar and soon to open is the Colonnade.

[Read More][61]

###### At The Hussain Sagar Lakeside

#### SAILING ANNEXE

The Secunderabad Club Sailing Annex offers an exceptional sailing experience on the pristine waters
of Hussain Sagar Lake . With state of the art boats and expert trainers , members can enjoy
recreational sailing or participate in competitive regattas .

[Explore More][62]

# More than just reservations

SevenRooms helps restaurants increase sales, delight guests and keep them coming back—automatically.

[Free 15 Minute Demo][6]
Meet SevenRooms in 2 Minutes

## Welcome to the table. Let's change the industry for good.

Join over 15,000 restaurants globally growing with SevenRooms, from local favorites to Michelin
stars.

FILL MORE SEATS

## Take reservations and fill more tables

Reach millions of diners wherever they book—your website, DoorDash Reservations, Deliveroo
Reservations, Google, Instagram, and Yelp. Convert more high-intent guests directly into your
reservation book. And now, with Voice AI, you’ll never miss a call-in reservation.

[Learn More][7]
SEAT & SERVE WITH EASE

## AI- powered table management that seats guests faster

Streamline every FOH shift with smart seating, pacing controls, cover forecasting and waitlist
automation. AI Table Management optimizes turns in real time, giving your team a smoother service
and your guests a better experience.

[Learn More][8]
Turn Guest Data into Higher Checks

## Fuel smarter upsells and better experiences with guest data

Automatically capture and unify guest data across every booking, visit and order to understand diner
preferences and spend—then turn those insights into personalized upsells, experiences, marketing and
reservation add-ons that increase revenue before guests arrive.

[Learn More][9]
BRING DINERS BACK AUTOMATICALLY

## Automated marketing that drives repeat visits

Trigger perfectly timed email, SMS and campaign journeys to your best guests with marketing tools
purpose-built for restaurants. Promote events, fill slower nights, celebrate special occasions,
turning one-time visitors into loyal regulars, without lifting a finger.

[Learn More][10]
"Before SevenRooms, using multiple reservation systems made for scattered data collection and
operational headaches. Now we have a single view of our guests and can follow up with each one
automatically, strengthening those relationships while generating passive revenue."

Paulina Oktari Halim, Group Marketing Manager, Brotzeit

# More than just reservations

SevenRooms helps restaurants increase sales, delight guests and keep them coming back—automatically.

Meet SevenRooms in 2 Minutes

## Welcome to the table. Let's change the industry for good.

Join over 15,000 restaurants globally growing with SevenRooms, from local favorites to Michelin
stars.

FILL MORE SEATS

## Take reservations and fill more tables

Reach millions of diners wherever they book—your website, DoorDash Reservations, Deliveroo
Reservations, Google, Instagram, and Yelp. Convert more high-intent guests directly into your
reservation book. And now, with Voice AI, you’ll never miss a call-in reservation.

[Learn More][7]
SEAT & SERVE WITH EASE

## AI- powered table management that seats guests faster

Streamline every FOH shift with smart seating, pacing controls, cover forecasting and waitlist
automation. AI Table Management optimizes turns in real time, giving your team a smoother service
and your guests a better experience.

[Learn More][8]
Turn Guest Data into Higher Checks

## Fuel smarter upsells and better experiences with guest data

Automatically capture and unify guest data across every booking, visit and order to understand diner
preferences and spend—then turn those insights into personalized upsells, experiences, marketing and
reservation add-ons that increase revenue before guests arrive.

[Learn More][9]
BRING DINERS BACK AUTOMATICALLY

## Automated marketing that drives repeat visits

Trigger perfectly timed email, SMS and campaign journeys to your best guests with marketing tools
purpose-built for restaurants. Promote events, fill slower nights, celebrate special occasions,
turning one-time visitors into loyal regulars, without lifting a finger.

## Услуги

#### Организация производства

[Организация производства][47]
❯

Мы осуществляем подписание внешнеторгового договора с дистрибьютором от вашего лица или от лица
компании Tradest.

Подробнее об услугах:
* [Инспекция качества товара][48]
* [Выкуп товаров][49]
* [Поиск поставщиков][50]

#### Аутсорсинг ВЭД: выкуп и логистика товара

[Аутсорсинг ВЭД: выкуп и логистика товара][51]
❯

Комплексный спектр услуг включает: установление связей с заводом-производителем, организацию
перевода платежей, проведение [таможенного оформления][52], [сертификацию продукции][53], а также
логистические операции. Мы охватываем работу с различными видами товаров:
* [Промышленное оборудование][54]
* [Медицинские изделия][55]
* [Детские товары][56]

#### Доставка грузов

[Доставка грузов ][57]
❯

Мы осуществляем забор продукции от вашего поставщика и её транспортировку на ваш склад.
Предоставляем услуги доставки как [сборных][58] так и крупногабаритных грузов, а также занимаемся
организацией [контейнерных перевозок][59].
* [Автоперевозки][60]
* [Морским транспортом][61]
* [Самолетом][62]
* [Железной дорогой][63]
* [Белая доставка][64]

#### Консалтинг

[Консалтинг][65]
❯

Предоставляем широкий спектр консультационных услуг в области международной торговли, включая советы
по законодательным нормам и условиям доставки, анализ и оценку торговых договоров и других
документов, а также помощь в выборе соответствующих кодов ТН ВЭД.

Обеспечиваем возможности для эффективного снижения рисков, связанных с внешнеэкономической
деятельностью.

#### Параллельный импорт

[Параллельный импорт][66]
❯

Мы осуществим законную закупку необходимого вам товара: определим подходящего поставщика, обеспечим
подготовку всех необходимых документов, наладим взаимодействие с производственным предприятием,
проведем контроль качества продукции и обеспечим её доставку на ваш склад в России.

#### поиск товара для Маркетплейсов

[Поиск товара для маркетплейсов][67]
❯

Мы предоставляем полный спектр услуг для входа на маркетплейсы: от закупки и доставки товаров на ваш
склад до помощи с таможенным оформлением и переводом финансовых средств за границу. Также возьмем на
себя оформление всех требуемых лицензий и сертификатов для работы на маркетплейсах.

## Максимально удобная схема работы

От вас потребуется только сообщить контакты поставщика и адрес доставки в России, а мы закроем все

## Изучили все тонкости и нюансы доставки грузов из Китая в Россию

**Мы точно знаем, как добиться от фабрики необходимого качества, как правильно перевести деньги за
товар и доставить его в Россию. Даже если речь идет о санкционных категориях.**

#### Как вы переводите деньги в Китай?
* Для начала мы объясняем фабрикам на китайском языке, как принять деньги из России в условиях
  санкций 
* Затем мы делаем юридически корректные документы для быстрого прохождения валютного контроля и
  последующей таможенной очистки в РФ. Готовим договор с поставщиком до запуска проекта, чтобы
  сократить время исполнения платежа 
* После этого отправляем деньги через наших агентов, за которых мы ручаемся
* А еще мы организуем закупку у фабрик без экспортной лицензии с помощью наших экспортных агентов в
  Китае, а также у фабрик, не готовых показывать связь с РФ

#### Как вы работаете с поставщиком?
* Мы организуем КОНТРАКТНОЕ производство. Т.е. товар на фабрике производится под вас. Это может быть
  как типовой товар, так и кастомизированный
* Следовательно, мы можем договориться и о кастомизации: от простой в виде логотипа до сложной в
  виде создания нового продукта
* Можем взять на себя весь процесс поиска необходимой продукции в Китае по вашему ТЗ и предоставляем
  выбор из нескольких надежных поставщиков, а также привозим образцы понравившихся товаров, чтобы вы
  лично проверили соответствие желаемому качеству, внешнему виду и функциональности
* Выйдем на связь с поставщиком на китайском языке, когда у вас есть только ссылка на их сайт или
  название фабрики

#### Как вы добиваетесь от поставщика нужного качества?
* Мы проводим переговоры с китайскими поставщиками по условиям контракта. Прописываем в договоре
  санкции если поставщик нарушил сроки производства и возмещение денежных средств в случае брака
* Организуем конфколлы на китайском языке, для верного понимания фабрикой что нужно произвести

#### У нас сложный технический продукт. Вы за такое беретесь?
* Да. Для начала мы делаем перевод на китайский сложной технической документации
* Организуем выезд нашего человека в Китае на контроль качества продукции (убеждаемся в том, что
  фабрика действительно произвела нужный продукт). Можем организовать инспекцию в режиме онлайн с
  вашим присутствием
* Проводим лабораторные исследования образцов товаров
* Организуем визит китайских специалистов в РФ для пусконаладочных работ

#### Какие гарантии?
* Мы фиксируем цену на весь проект, включая транспорт и таможню перед стартом проекта. Цена
  окончательная, без скрытых платежей. Исключение - изменение веса и габаритов груза фабрикой после
  окончания производства
* Мы работаем по агентскому договору. Вы видите на что уходят ваши деньги
* А до заключения договора мы составим прозрачное КП, где будут расписаны все статьи затрат
* Работаем полностью в белую. Вы легко можете проверить наши юр. лица: ООО "Стандард" и ООО
  "Трейдест" на любых порталах анализа контрагентов
* И, главное, мы работаем на рынке с 2012 года. Мы пережили присоединение Крыма, пандемию Ковида,
  конфликт на Украине и пакеты санкций. Отзывы о нас легко ищутся. Все эти годы мы работаем достойно

## Изучили все тонкости и нюансы доставки грузов из Китая в Россию

**Мы точно знаем, как добиться от фабрики необходимого качества, как правильно перевести деньги за
товар и доставить его в Россию. Даже если речь идет о санкционных категориях.**

#### Как вы переводите деньги в Китай?
* Для начала мы объясняем фабрикам на китайском языке, как принять деньги из России в условиях
  санкций 
* Затем мы делаем юридически корректные документы для быстрого прохождения валютного контроля и
  последующей таможенной очистки в РФ. Готовим договор с поставщиком до запуска проекта, чтобы
  сократить время исполнения платежа 
* После этого отправляем деньги через наших агентов, за которых мы ручаемся
* А еще мы организуем закупку у фабрик без экспортной лицензии с помощью наших экспортных агентов в
  Китае, а также у фабрик, не готовых показывать связь с РФ

#### Как вы работаете с поставщиком?
* Мы организуем КОНТРАКТНОЕ производство. Т.е. товар на фабрике производится под вас. Это может быть
  как типовой товар, так и кастомизированный
* Следовательно, мы можем договориться и о кастомизации: от простой в виде логотипа до сложной в
  виде создания нового продукта
* Можем взять на себя весь процесс поиска необходимой продукции в Китае по вашему ТЗ и предоставляем
  выбор из нескольких надежных поставщиков, а также привозим образцы понравившихся товаров, чтобы вы
  лично проверили соответствие желаемому качеству, внешнему виду и функциональности
* Выйдем на связь с поставщиком на китайском языке, когда у вас есть только ссылка на их сайт или
  название фабрики

#### Как вы добиваетесь от поставщика нужного качества?
* Мы проводим переговоры с китайскими поставщиками по условиям контракта. Прописываем в договоре
  санкции если поставщик нарушил сроки производства и возмещение денежных средств в случае брака
* Организуем конфколлы на китайском языке, для верного понимания фабрикой что нужно произвести

#### У нас сложный технический продукт. Вы за такое беретесь?
* Да. Для начала мы делаем перевод на китайский сложной технической документации
* Организуем выезд нашего человека в Китае на контроль качества продукции (убеждаемся в том, что
  фабрика действительно произвела нужный продукт). Можем организовать инспекцию в режиме онлайн с
  вашим присутствием
* Проводим лабораторные исследования образцов товаров
* Организуем визит китайских специалистов в РФ для пусконаладочных работ

#### Какие гарантии?
* Мы фиксируем цену на весь проект, включая транспорт и таможню перед стартом проекта. Цена
  окончательная, без скрытых платежей. Исключение - изменение веса и габаритов груза фабрикой после
  окончания производства
* Мы работаем по агентскому договору. Вы видите на что уходят ваши деньги
* А до заключения договора мы составим прозрачное КП, где будут расписаны все статьи затрат
* Работаем полностью в белую. Вы легко можете проверить наши юр. лица: ООО "Стандард" и ООО
  "Трейдест" на любых порталах анализа контрагентов
* И, главное, мы работаем на рынке с 2012 года. Мы пережили присоединение Крыма, пандемию Ковида,
  конфликт на Украине и пакеты санкций. Отзывы о нас легко ищутся. Все эти годы мы работаем достойно

### How Does it Work?

Keep practicing each lesson until you get all five stars. It really doesn't take much to learn, a
few minutes a day for one to two weeks and you will be a pro!

### Do I need an account?

You do not need to create an account. However, as you go through the lessons, you can create an
optional profile in order to save your progress.

###### Inside TypingClub

### All the reasons to start learning how to type right now

**It's a game.** An engaging and interactive experience while you are learning how to type.

**Proper hand posture guide.** Will show you the correct hand posture on every key as you type.

**Levels, Badges and Stars.** All the reasons to keep you going, and build your muscle memory.

**Accessibility.** TypingClub is the most accessible typing program available.

**Interactive experience.** A full range of experiences from games, videos and different typing
challenges makes learning fun.

**Voice over.** Once you turn it on, every word is read out loud as you are typing each word.

**Typing Playback.** You can view your past performances and even play them back.

**Google for Education Partner.** TypingClub is a Google for Education Partner

**100% Online.** All you need is a keyboard and a web browser.
